name: Glaucous-Corbel
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by massive canyon systems. Beyond ancient meteor crater, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
